00227                                 @param table    A single channel Buffer used as a lookup table. Here an input           \
00228                                                 value of inLow would output the first value in the table, an            \
00229                                                 input value of inHigh would output the last value in the table.         \
00230                                                 An input value half way between inLow and inHigh would output the       \
00231                                                 value in the middle of the table, and so on.
